data.text: I’d prefer 10 tons each. That gives every household $10,000 this month, leaves enough fish to restore the lake to 100 tons, and saves us keeping track of a rotation. I’m comfortable taking 7.5 under a fully agreed rotation, but it sounds like most of us favor the simpler arrangement. Luke, would you be happy with 10 each instead? We can review our catches together at month’s end and keep protecting the lake our village depends on.
